title: Assessing Generalization for Subpopulation Representative Modeling via In-Context Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities in fidelity error (the difference between LLM-predicted responses and empirical ANES survey data) across different racial groups (e.g., non-Hispanic White, Black, Hispanic) when using in-context learning.
Comparing the fidelity error of the model's simulated survey responses across different political party affiliations (e.g., Democrat vs. Republican).
Evaluating the fidelity error of the model's simulated responses against empirical ground truth data across different income brackets and educational attainment levels.
Assessing the disparity in fidelity error of LLM-simulated survey responses compared to ground truth data across different age demographics.
Measuring the disparity in fidelity error between male and female demographic subgroups when predicting feeling thermometer survey responses.
